free_tier_limits.correction: Tenderly Free provides browser-based Explorer, Debugger, and single-transaction simulation. It has no API or Node RPC access, so it does not include monthly API/RPC units.

rate_limits.correction: Node RPC documentation publishes Tenderly Unit costs per method, but account capacity and limits must be discussed with sales; no current general plan/dashboard quota schedule is published.

description.correction: Tenderly currently calls its forked testing product Virtual Environments. REST access tokens are tied to a personal account or organization, not scoped to a project, although many REST paths contain account and project slugs.

notes: The service and documented REST simulation endpoint remain operational. The entry's main failure is outdated commercial information: Free is now browser-only with no API or Node RPC access. Its project-scoped-key wording and Virtual TestNets terminology are also outdated.
